subject: WillowBank MAP: security checkpoints, retention decisions, and timeline
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@willowbank.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@willowbank.com>
Date: 2026-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WillowBank MAP: security checkpoints, retention decisions, and timeline

Hi Grace — thanks for the kickoff earlier. Per our conversation, WillowBank needs a succinct MAP that spells out the security gates we need to clear before Procurement signs. Our must-haves are: (1) current SOC 2 Type II evidence, (2) SIG/CAIQ answers for our application flow, (3) a DPA with clear data retention and deletion language for PII, and (4) confirmation of data residency for accounts created in our US regions. Can you propose a timeline (we're targeting go/no-go by 2026-04-16)?

Also — curious about your suggested acceptance criteria for the evaluation phase (what does "security acceptance" look like from Redwood's side?). Please include an explicit owner for each gate.

Thanks,
Aisha
Director, Infrastructure Risk
WillowBank

Attachment: Willow_Risk_Summary_2026.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@willowbank.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WillowBank MAP: security checkpoints, retention decisions, and timeline

Hi Aisha — appreciate the clear list. I sketched an initial MAP and ownership matrix and attached it (WillowBank_MAP_v1.xlsx). High level answers to your bullets below, followed by a proposed milestone lane through 2026-04-16.

1) SOC 2 Type II: Redwood will provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. Ben (Security) will own delivery and redaction guidance. Acceptance: WillowBank signs NDA and confirms report meets your audit team's needs.

2) SIG/CAIQ: We completed a CAIQ-style questionnaire and attached a working response (SIG_CAIC_Qs_responses_v0.9.pdf). Lauren (Solutions) will coordinate remaining clarifications. Acceptance: WillowBank reviews responses and marks any items requiring evidence or controls refinement.

3) DPA & retention: Our standard DPA allows configurable retention windows per customer. Proposed defaults: session logs retained 90 days, aggregated analytics 2 years, legal archives up to 7 years where required. We can scope a contract appendix for shorter retention. Acceptance: Legal signs off on agreed windows or records carveouts.

4) Data residency & encryption: All customer data for your US tenant will be stored in US regions (primary and DR in separate zones). Data encrypted at rest with KMS and in transit with TLS 1.2+. Ben will share a short KMS/key-management note. Acceptance: Compliance confirms residency and key controls.

Proposed milestone lane (brief):
- 2026-03-22: NDA + MAP acknowledgment (owner: Aisha / Grace)
- 2026-03-24: SOC 2 report transfer (owner: Ben)
- 2026-03-26: CAIQ clarifications delivered (owner: Lauren)
- 2026-04-02: DPA redlines exchanged (owner: WillowBank Legal / Redwood Legal)
- 2026-04-09: Evidence intake workshop (owner: Ben / Willow security SMEs)
- 2026-04-14: Final acceptance window opens (owner: Aisha)
- 2026-04-16: Go/no-go decision (target)

I'll flag items that require proactive engineering work (e.g., a short-lived key rotation runbook) in the MAP. Can you confirm if WillowBank requires a signed DPA before we share any SOC artifacts? If so we'll prioritize legal and move DPA redlines to the top.

Thanks — grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: WillowBank_MAP_v1.xlsx, SIG_CAIC_Qs_responses_v0.9.pdf

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: WillowBank MAP — evidence & owners

Team — quick internal note so we have the right set:
- I'll handle SOC 2 handoff. I'll prepare a redacted PDF and an index of controls that map to WillowBank's list.
- Lauren: please review the SIG responses for any "requires evidence" flags; call out items that need short follow-up artifacts (architecture diagram, network ACL list, runbook snippets).
- Grace: if Willow asks for a shorter retention window than our defaults, I'll draft a proposed contractual language (appendix) and a tech path to enforce shorter retention for logs.

We should be ready to run an evidence intake call on 2026-04-02. I'll draft a 30-minute agenda and a lightweight evidence template.

-ben
Ben Carter
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@willowbank.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@willowbank.com>, WillowBank Legal <legal@willowbank.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WillowBank MAP: security checkpoints, retention decisions, and timeline

Thanks Grace — this is helpful. WillowBank will require a signed DPA before our procurement team will accept the SOC 2 report into our vendor system. Can Redwood share the DPA redline window by 2026-03-27?

Also: two clarifications from Willow security: (1) for retention, we need a mechanism to request immediate deletion of a specific user's PII that propagates to backups within 30 days (if technically feasible), and (2) for SIG responses, items flagged as "partial" should include a short remediation plan and ETA.

We'll review the MAP spreadsheet overnight and circle back with owners by EOD 2026-03-24.

— Aisha

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@willowbank.com>, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-26T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WillowBank MAP: security checkpoints, retention decisions, and timeline

Aisha — thanks for the quick clarifications. A couple of concrete updates: 

• DPA timeline: Redwood Legal will send a first redline by 2026-03-27 (we'll include the retention appendix and a target clause for expedited deletion).
• Backup deletion: technically we currently support targeted deletion for live stores; backups are on a snapshot cadence. Ben will propose an operational pattern that attempts restore-filtering and accelerated removal within 30 days; if your legal team needs a contractual guarantee for 30-day backup purge we will mark this as a contractual carveout and propose an escrow-style mitigation during the first 12 months.
• SIG follow-ups: we've annotated the SIG_CAIC_Qs_responses_v0.9.pdf for partial items and added remediation plans with rough ETAs (see attached).

Next steps: we'll finalize the MAP v1.1 with owners and evidence links right after we send the DPA redline. Proposed intake call remains 2026-04-02; Ben will run the session and capture outstanding evidence.

If that schedule works for Willow please reply with a quick ACK on this thread and list the primary security contact you want on the intake call.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
